description: The + / - operators on DATE and TIMESTAMP values, matching live: DATE +- int shifts by days staying a DATE (commutative), TIMESTAMP +- int is rejected at compile time (use DATEADD), DATE - DATE is the signed integer day count, +- INTERVAL applies the unit with the keyword-unit spelling promoting DATE to TIMESTAMP for DAY-or-finer units (midnight) while MONTH/YEAR preserve the DATE, CURRENT_DATE arithmetic works in WHERE, NULL temporals propagate, non-date string arithmetic still errors and plain numeric arithmetic is unaffected. Interval renders pinned via SQL-side stringification. Converted 1:1 from expressions/DateTimeArithmeticOperatorTest (now retired).
